records.source: [NPC] Nuvian: Are you a Wizard?
records.authored_tsv_row: Nuvian|Are you a Wizard?|Ты волшебник?

records.source: [NPC] Nuvian: Well you don't look like one, and you don't smell like one either.
records.authored_tsv_row: Nuvian|Well you don't look like one, and you don't smell like one either.|Ну, не похож. И пахнешь не как волшебник.

records.authored_tsv_row: Nuvian|Hello stranger. Are you looking to join our faction?|Здравствуй, чужеземец. Хочешь вступить в нашу фракцию?

records.source: [NPC] Nuvian: What a fantastic choice!
records.authored_tsv_row: Nuvian|What a fantastic choice!|Какой прекрасный выбор!

records.source: [NPC] Nuvian: We have a range of motives far deeper and more interesting than those terrible fire mages.
records.authored_tsv_row: Nuvian|We have a range of motives far deeper and more interesting than those terrible fire mages.|Наши устремления куда глубже и интереснее, чем у этих ужасных огненных магов.

records.source: [NPC] Nuvian: Are you a Hero?
records.authored_tsv_row: Nuvian|Are you a Hero?|Ты герой?

records.source: [NPC] Nuvian: Did you come to free us from the everlasting threat of the wizards?
